o1:
Predicted to enable Rho-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. 

Involved in embryonic body morphogenesis, embryonic morphogenesis, embryonic body elongation, establishment or maintenance of cell polarity, embryonic cell polarity, apical junction remodeling, regulation of the actomyosin contractile ring assembly, gonad development, endocytic recycling, hypodermal P cell migration, adherens junction organization, actomyosin-based cell contraction, cytokinesis, ovulation, vulval tube morphogenesis, spermathecal contraction, nematode pharyngeal gland morphogenesis, and nematode pharynx development. 

Is located in adherens junction; contractile muscle fiber; nucleus; early endosome; actomyosin filaments; apical plasma membrane; and cleavage furrow. 

Is expressed in lateral epidermal cells; spermathecal valves; intestine; germline; P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; hypodermis; reproductive system; seam cells; secondary (2°) vulval lineage; and tail. 

Is part of Rho-mediated signal transduction; endocytic recycling; embryonic elongation; Wnt/planar cell polarity signaling; let-502/mel-11; and cytokinetic pathways. 

Interacts with MLC-4; MEL-11; RHO-1; RAB-5; RABX-5; and CED-10. 

LET-502 ameliorates the membrane-ruffling phenotype. 

Orthologous to human ROCK1 (Rho associated coiled-coil containing protein kinase 1) and ROCK2 (Rho associated coiled-coil containing protein kinase 2).
